text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As summer camp comes to an end, I ask Super Creek how she feels about her summer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I had a really pleasant time. My mind felt completely free, unlike last year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Not having a single worry really is wonderful. It means we can focus on other things.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We can squint our eyes beneath the harsh sun above as we walk towards a brighter future, slowly working together day by day…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, speaking of which… have you gotten a little tan, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. Awww, it's like you're growing up right before my very eyes. You're not a fledgling trainer anymore…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I bet other Umamusume will be latching onto you now too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Just remember—wandering off with other Umamusume just because they ask you to is a big no-no!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We've got to keep our eyes on the fall G1 series, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Duly reminded, I resolve to buckle down and work towards the autumn Tenno Sho.
